title: AllDayNav: Lifelong Navigation via Real-World Reinforcement Learning
summary: Lifelong embodied navigation in dynamic environments requires robots to form persistent scene understanding from fragmentary observations, which remains difficult for existing methods that rely on explicit maps or scene graphs and struggle to generalize beyond structured settings. We propose AllDayNav, a lifelong self-learning navigation framework that implicitly encodes scene dynamics into the billion-scale parameters of a large model via reinforcement learning, powered by a self-evolving multimodal memory that maintains and updates visual keyframes, semantic descriptions, and temporal context while autonomously generating open-vocabulary instructions, image goals, and structured rewards. Experiments in both synthetic and real-world environments across cross-room, cross-episode, and cross-task scenarios show that AllDayNav achieves success rates approaching $100\%$ and consistently surpasses strong map-based, VLM, and RL baselines in path efficiency and robustness, demonstrating implicit, memory-driven reinforcement learning as a scalable alternative to explicit mapping for reliable lifelong navigation.
tldr: AllDayNav proposes a lifelong navigation framework that uses reinforcement learning and a self-evolving multimodal memory to implicitly encode scene dynamics into a large model, achieving near-perfect success rates across diverse real-world and synthetic environments without explicit mapping.
tldr_zh: AllDayNav 提出了一种终身导航框架，通过强化学习和自演进多模态记忆将场景动态隐式编码到大模型中，无需显式建图即可在各种真实和合成环境中实现接近100%的成功率。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
在动态环境中实现终身具身导航，要求机器人能够从碎片化观测中形成持续的场景理解，而现有依赖显式地图或场景图的方法难以推广至非结构化场景，仍面临挑战。我们提出AllDayNav——一种终身自学习导航框架，通过强化学习将场景动态隐式编码至大模型的十亿级参数中，并依托自我演化的多模态记忆模块，该模块可维护与更新视觉关键帧、语义描述及时间上下文，同时自主生成开放词汇指令、图像目标与结构化奖励。在跨房间、跨回合及跨任务场景的合成与现实环境实验中，AllDayNav的成功率接近100%，并在路径效率与鲁棒性上持续超越基于地图、VLM及强化学习的强基线方法，证明隐式记忆驱动强化学习可作为显式地图构建的可扩展替代方案，实现可靠的终身导航。

title: Uncovering Vulnerability of Vision-Language-Action Models under Joint-Level Physical Faults
summary: Deploying Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models in real robotic systems requires robustness not only to semantic and perceptual variations, but also to embodiment-side faults that change how actions are physically realized. Real robots can experience joint-level changes caused by actuator degradation, hardware faults, safety limits, collision damage, or wear-induced friction. These faults are critical because they alter the action-to-motion interface of a policy, disrupting the learned closed-loop relationship between commanded actions, realized motion, and subsequent observations. In this work, we study realistic joint-level physical faults and show that VLA models are vulnerable when predicted actions are executed through a perturbed robot body. Our analysis reveals joint-dependent effects, with heterogeneous degradation in task success across affected joints. We also show that performance drops cannot be attributed solely to physical infeasibility, since feasible faults such as increased joint friction can still substantially reduce success rates and induce closed-loop execution mismatch. Motivated by these findings, we propose Joint-level Physical-fault Aware Residual Calibrator (J-PARC), a lightweight residual calibration framework built on top of a frozen VLA policy. J-PARC infers a latent joint-fault regime from recent joint dynamics and conditions a shared residual calibrator on this regime, enabling adaptive action correction across faulty joints. Experiments show that J-PARC improves robustness under joint-level faults while preserving fault-free environment performance.
tldr: This paper identifies and analyzes vulnerabilities of VLA models under realistic joint-level physical faults in robots, and proposes J-PARC, a lightweight residual calibration framework that adaptively corrects actions based on inferred joint-fault regimes, improving robustness while preserving fault-free performance.
tldr_zh: 本文发现并分析了VLA模型在真实机器人关节级物理故障下的脆弱性，并提出了一种轻量级残差校准框架J-PARC，基于推断的关节故障模式自适应修正动作，提升了鲁棒性且不损害无故障性能。
summary_zh: 在真实机器人系统中部署视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型时，不仅需要应对语义和感知层面的变化，还需处理改变动作物理实现方式的实体侧故障。真实机器人可能因执行器退化、硬件故障、安全限制、碰撞损伤或摩擦磨损等因素引发关节级变化。这类故障至关重要，因为它们会改变策略的动作-运动接口，破坏指令动作、实现运动与后续观测之间习得的闭环关系。本研究聚焦于真实的关节级物理故障，并证明当预测动作通过受扰动的机器人本体执行时，VLA模型存在脆弱性。分析揭示出关节依赖效应，不同受影响关节的任务成功率呈现异质性退化。研究还表明，性能下降不能仅归因于物理不可行性——因为即使增加关节摩擦这类可行故障，仍可能显著降低成功率并引发闭环执行失配。基于这些发现，我们提出关节级物理故障感知残差校准器（J-PARC），这是一种构建于冻结VLA策略之上的轻量级残差校准框架。J-PARC从近期关节动力学中推断潜在关节故障模式，并基于该模式对共享残差校准器进行条件化处理，从而实现对故障关节的自适应动作修正。实验表明，J-PARC在保持无故障环境性能的同时，提升了关节级故障下的鲁棒性。

title: What Matters in Orchestrating Robot Policies: A Systematic Study of Hierarchical VLA Agents
summary: Hierarchical vision-language-action (Hi-VLA) systems have emerged as a promising paradigm for complex robot manipulation, by using high-level VLM planners to decompose tasks into language subgoals executed by low-level VLA controllers. Despite recent empirical progress, there is a lack of unified design principles for these systems: existing Hi-VLA systems differ in how they choose and connect planners, controllers, mechanisms to switch between the two, and how observations and memory are represented in the planner. In this paper, we present a systematic study of Hi-VLA design for robot manipulation. We unify representative Hi-VLA agents under an options-style control framework and benchmark core design choices across short-horizon, long-horizon, and reasoning-intensive tasks. Our analysis distills practical principles for building Hi-VLA systems, showing how model choices and interface mechanisms jointly shape performance. Applying these principles yields a substantially stronger system than either flat VLA control or a naively designed hierarchy, across experiments both in simulation and on a real ALOHA robot. Overall, our results provide a foundation for building more capable, robust, and principled hierarchical VLA agents. More information and video at jiahenghu.github.io/hi-vla.
tldr: A systematic study of hierarchical VLA (Hi-VLA) systems for robot manipulation, unifying design choices under an options-style framework and distilling principles that yield a stronger system than flat VLA or naive hierarchies.
tldr_zh: 对用于机器人操作的层次化VLA系统进行系统研究，在选项式控制框架下统一设计选择，并提炼出比扁平VLA或简单层级更强大的系统构建原则。
summary_zh: 分层视觉-语言-动作（Hi-VLA）系统通过利用高层VLM规划器将任务分解为由低层VLA控制器执行的子目标语言指令，已成为复杂机器人操作任务中颇具前景的范式。尽管近期取得了实证进展，但这些系统仍缺乏统一的设计原则：现有Hi-VLA系统在规划器与控制器的选择方式、两者间的切换机制、以及规划器中观测信息与记忆的表示方法上均存在差异。本文针对机器人操作中的Hi-VLA设计进行了系统性研究。我们将具有代表性的Hi-VLA智能体统一至基于选项风格的控制框架下，并围绕短视距、长视距及高推理密集型任务对核心设计选择进行基准测试。通过分析，我们提炼出构建Hi-VLA系统的实用原则，揭示了模型选择与接口机制如何共同影响系统性能。在仿真环境与真实ALOHA机器人上的实验表明，应用这些原则所构建的系统在性能上显著优于扁平化VLA控制或朴素层级化设计方案。总体而言，本研究为构建能力更强、鲁棒性更优且更具理论性的层级化VLA智能体奠定了基础。更多信息及演示视频请访问jiahenghu.github.io/hi-vla。

title: BiWM: Advancing Open-Source Interactive Video World Models with Bidirectional Autoregression
summary: Transitioning bidirectional video diffusion models into an autoregressive paradigm improves the interactivity of video world models, but existing causal pipelines need many stages (control fine-tuning, autoregressive training, causal initialization, few-step distillation) and still trail bidirectional models in quality due to error accumulation. Recent world models such as Yume-1.5 and Matrix-Game-3.0 instead adopt a bidirectional autoregressive approach, gaining fidelity and stable long-horizon rollout from self-correcting error propagation, yet open-source frameworks (e.g., minWM) support only causal models. We present BiWM, the first full-stack framework for interactive video world models under the bidirectional autoregressive paradigm, jointly optimizing generation quality and inference speed. From a pretrained video backbone, BiWM injects camera control by fine-tuning, then runs a few-step Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) stage that turns the backbone into an action/camera-controllable world model: just two training stages instead of four in minWM, converging in a few hundred steps on 8xH200 GPUs. A single recipe spans Wan2.1-1.3B, Wan2.2-5B, HunyuanVideo-1.5-8B, and LTX-2.3-22B, and also supports secondary fine-tuning of existing bidirectional models. BiWM enables real-world camera control where minWM loses controllability, integrates pluggable history compression (FramePack-style and PackForcing-style) for long rollouts, and offers an optional NVFP4 4-bit training/inference pipeline. To counter DMD's mode-seeking degradation, we add GAN and mass-covering forward-KL objectives that preserve scene dynamics. We open-source BiWM for resource-constrained research and high-fidelity environment simulation.
tldr: BiWM is an open-source framework for interactive video world models that uses bidirectional autoregression to achieve high-fidelity, long-horizon rollout with a simple two-stage training pipeline, supporting multiple video backbones and real-world camera control.
tldr_zh: BiWM 是一个开放源码的交互式视频世界模型框架，采用双向自回归方法，通过简单的两阶段训练管道实现高保真度和长期稳定推演，支持多种视频主干和真实世界的摄像头控制。
summary_zh: 将双向视频扩散模型转换为自回归范式可提升视频世界模型的交互性，但现有因果流水线需要多个阶段（控制微调、自回归训练、因果初始化、少步蒸馏），且因误差累积导致质量仍落后于双向模型。近期世界模型（如Yume-1.5和Matrix-Game-3.0）转而采用双向自回归方法，通过自纠正误差传播获得保真度与稳定的长程推演能力，然而开源框架（如minWM）仅支持因果模型。我们提出BiWM，这是首个在双向自回归范式下实现交互式视频世界模型的全栈框架，联合优化生成质量与推理速度。基于预训练视频主干网络，BiWM通过微调注入摄像机控制，随后执行少步分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）阶段，将主干网络转化为动作/摄像机可控的世界模型：仅需两个训练阶段（minWM需四个阶段），在8×H200 GPU上数百步内收敛。单一方案即可适配Wan2.1-1.3B、Wan2.2-5B、HunyuanVideo-1.5-8B及LTX-2.3-22B模型，同时支持现有双向模型的二次微调。BiWM实现了minWM无法保持可控性的真实摄像机控制，集成可插拔历史压缩模块（FramePack风格与PackForcing风格）以支持长程推演，并提供可选的NVFP4 4位训练/推理流水线。针对DMD的模式寻求退化问题，我们引入GAN与质量覆盖前向KL目标以保持场景动态。BiWM已开源，适用于资源受限的研究场景与高保真环境仿真。

title: TacForeSight: Force-Guided Tactile World Model for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Contact-rich manipulation requires robots to continuously perceive and regulate evolving physical interactions under dynamic contact transitions or complex surface geometries. Recent imitation learning methods improve contact-aware control by incorporating tactile or force feedback, but they rarely model the asymmetric spatiotemporal roles of global force and local tactile sensing. To address this, we propose TacForeSight, a lightweight force-conditioned tactile foresight framework for real-time manipulation. The core component is TacForceWM, a tactile world model that predicts short-horizon tactile latent dynamics from dual-finger tactile observations conditioned on high-frequency wrist force and torque signals. Another key component, the Predictive Tactile-Conditioned Policy, leverages the predicted latents as anticipatory contact priors, models the current-to-future tactile evolution via cross-attention, and adaptively fuses visuo-tactile features through a tactile-guided gating module. By forecasting purely within a compact latent space, TacForeSight enables proactive contact reasoning with efficient real-time inference suitable for high-frequency manipulation control. Real-robot experiments on five representative tasks and three in-process perturbation settings show that TacForeSight consistently outperforms existing baselines, particularly under dynamic contact disturbances. All models and datasets will be made publicly available on the project website at https://tacforesight.github.io/ProjectPage.
tldr: TacForeSight introduces a force-conditioned tactile world model that predicts tactile latent dynamics for contact-rich manipulation, enabling proactive contact reasoning and improved performance under dynamic disturbances.
tldr_zh: TacForeSight 提出了一种力条件触觉世界模型，通过预测触觉潜在动力学实现接触丰富的操作，在动态干扰下表现出更优的性能。
summary_zh: 接触丰富的操作要求机器人能够在动态接触转变或复杂表面几何条件下，持续感知并调控不断演化的物理交互。近年来，模仿学习方法通过引入触觉或力觉反馈提升了接触感知控制能力，但这类方法很少建模全局力与局部触觉感知在时空上的非对称作用。为解决这一问题，我们提出TacForeSight——一种轻量级的力条件触觉前瞻框架，用于实时操作。其核心组件是TacForceWM，一种触觉世界模型，能够以高频腕部力与力矩信号为条件，从双指触觉观测中预测短时程的触觉潜在动态。另一关键组件——预测性触觉条件策略——利用预测的潜在变量作为预期接触先验，通过交叉注意力建模当前到未来的触觉演化，并借助触觉引导门控模块自适应融合视觉-触觉特征。通过仅在紧凑潜在空间中进行预测，TacForeSight实现了前瞻性接触推理，具备适用于高频操作控制的高效实时推理能力。在五项代表性任务及三种过程扰动设置的实际机器人实验中，TacForeSight持续超越现有基线方法，尤其在动态接触扰动场景下表现优越。所有模型与数据集将在项目网站https://tacforesight.github.io/ProjectPage 上公开。

title: JOIN: Anchor-Grasp-Conditioned Joining via Opposition, Inference, and Navigation for Bimanual Assistive Manipulation
summary: Assistive mobility and manipulation platforms have received increasing attention as a means of restoring independence to individuals with disabilities. While effective for many basic activities of daily living (ADLs), a significant percentage of everyday tasks such as opening a jar, pouring a liquid, lifting a tray, or basic meal preparation, is fundamentally bimanual and remains out of reach for any single-arm system. Adding a second arm to a wheelchair is impractical, due to the additional power draw, cost, and the loss of space required for transfers and mobility. We instead propose a heterogeneous, on-demand bimanual system, in which a wheelchair-mounted anchor arm is joined when needed by a summoned mobile manipulator that serves as a complement arm. The central technical problem, which we call bimanual joining, is conditional: the anchor has already committed to a grasp, and the complement arm must choose where to stand and what to grasp to complete the task. We formulate bimanual joining as a three-phase decomposition (plan, drive, grasp) and show that a vision-language model (VLM), coupled with standard geometric tools, provides task-level knowledge sufficient to solve a representative class of bimanual ADLs. Our system JOIN, contributes (i) a wheelchair-referenced opposition score, and (ii) task-conditioned directional manipulability. We evaluate JOIN on a Kinova Gen3 anchor and a Hello Robot Stretch~3 complement on representative same-object and different-object tasks. JOIN accomplished more attempts (19/20) than state-of-the-art methods (14/20) and required markedly less correction by the operator.
tldr: This paper presents JOIN, a heterogeneous on-demand bimanual assistive system using a VLM to coordinate a wheelchair-mounted anchor arm with a summoned mobile manipulator for bimanual activities of daily living.
tldr_zh: 本文提出JOIN，一种异构按需双臂辅助系统，利用视觉语言模型协调轮椅上的锚定臂与召唤的移动操作臂，完成日常生活中的双臂任务。
summary_zh: 辅助移动与操作平台作为恢复残障人士独立生活能力的手段，正受到日益广泛的关注。尽管这类平台能有效完成许多基本日常生活活动，但仍有相当比例的日常任务——如开瓶、倒液体、端托盘或简单备餐——本质上是双手协同完成的，任何单臂系统都无法胜任。为轮椅增加第二只机械臂并不可行，因为这会带来额外的能耗、成本，以及因转移和移动需求而损失空间。我们转而提出一种异构的按需双手操作系统：当需要时，安装在轮椅上的锚定臂与一台被召来的移动操作机器人（作为辅助臂）协同工作。其核心技术问题——我们称之为"双手接合"——具有条件性：锚定臂已预先执行抓取动作，辅助臂必须选择站立位置与抓取目标以完成任务。我们将双手接合分解为三个相位（规划、移动、抓取），并证明视觉-语言模型结合标准几何工具，能提供足以解决代表性双手日常生活活动的任务级知识。我们的JOIN系统贡献了：（i）基于轮椅参照的对向评分，以及（ii）任务条件化的方向可操作性。我们在Kinova Gen3锚定臂与Hello Robot Stretch~3辅助臂上，针对代表性的同物体与异物体任务进行了评估。JOIN系统实现了更高成功率（19/20，对比前沿方法的14/20），且所需操作员修正显著减少。

title: RoboNaldo: Accurate, Stable and Powerful Humanoid Soccer Shooting via Motion-Guided Curriculum Reinforcement Learning
summary: Elite humanoid soccer shooting requires whole-body stability, high-impulse whole-body interactions, and accuracy to targets. Motion tracking-driven reinforcement learning (RL) provides stability in whole-body movement coordination, but a fixed reference makes it hard to adapt to varied ball positions and strike timings; in contrast, task reward-driven RL struggles to explore and discover valid kicks from scratch. We therefore introduce RoboNaldo, a three-stage motion-guided curriculum RL framework for high-impulse humanoid interaction. A single human-kick reference is used as a scaffold and progressively shifts optimization towards shooting performance. The curriculum first learns a stable whole-body kicking prior, then adapts the kick to free-kick settings where the ball is stationary at random positions, and finally extends it to moving-ball shooting through a locomotion-command and kick-trigger interface. A high-level heuristic planner controls this interface during training, while alternative high-level controllers can drive the same low-level policy at inference. In simulation, RoboNaldo demonstrates free-kick shot error 48.6% lower and shoot velocity 2.96x than prior work baselines. In real world on a Unitree G1 with onboard perception, RoboNaldo attains 0.73 m and 0.86 m average target shooting error from 3 m away in free-kick and moving-ball cases, accordingly. And the post-contact ball velocity reaches 13.10 m/s, which is 59-71% of reported professional open-play shot speed. Project page: https://opendrivelab.com/RoboNaldo.
tldr: Proposes a three-stage motion-guided curriculum RL framework for humanoid soccer shooting, achieving accurate, stable, and powerful kicks from free-kick to moving-ball settings.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种三阶段运动引导的课程强化学习框架，用于人形机器人足球射门，实现了从任意位置定点射门到运动射门的准确、稳定且有力的踢球。
summary_zh: 精英人形足球射门需要全身稳定性、高冲量全身交互以及目标命中精度。运动追踪驱动的强化学习（RL）在全身运动协调方面提供了稳定性，但固定参考点使其难以适应多变的球位和击球时机；相比之下，任务奖励驱动的RL难以从头探索并发现有效的踢球动作。为此，我们提出RoboNaldo——一种面向高冲量人形交互的三阶段运动引导课程式强化学习框架。该框架以单次人类踢球动作为模板，逐步将优化重心转向射门表现。课程首先学习稳定的全身踢球先验知识，随后将踢球动作适应至球体静止于随机位置的任意球场景，最后通过运动指令与射门触发接口扩展至移动球射门。训练过程中，高层启发式规划器控制该接口，而替代性高层控制器可在推理时驱动相同的底层策略。在仿真环境中，RoboNaldo的任意球射门误差较先前基线方法降低48.6%，射门速度提升2.96倍。在搭载机载感知系统的宇树G1实体机器人上，RoboNaldo在任意球与移动球场景中，分别实现了从3米距离射门的0.73米和0.86米平均目标命中误差，且触球后球速达13.10米/秒，达到专业比赛开放式射门速度的59%至71%。项目页面：https://opendrivelab.com/RoboNaldo

title: Diffusion Forcing Planner: History-Annealed Planning with Time-Dependent Guidance for Autonomous Driving
summary: Learning-based motion planners, despite recent progress, often suffer from temporal inconsistency. Small perturbations across frames can accumulate into unstable trajectories, degrading comfort and safety in closed-loop driving. Several methods attempt to inject history as a static conditioning signal to stabilize outputs, only to induce the planner to copy historical patterns instead of adapting to environment contexts. To address this limitation, we propose Diffusion Forcing Planner (DFP), a diffusion-based planning framework driven by history-guided control. Specifically, DFP decomposes the full trajectory into history, current and future segments, and assign independent noise levels to each segment. The model jointly denoises the historical and the future segments, enforcing a heterogeneous joint diffusion process. At inference, classifier-free guidance (CFG) is applied to steer future sampling using annealed history in a controllable manner. Closed-loop evaluation and comprehensive ablations on nuPlan show that DFP achieves competitive performance while producing continuous, stable, and controllable motion plans in complex driving scenarios.
tldr: Proposes Diffusion Forcing Planner (DFP) for autonomous driving, which uses a heterogeneous joint diffusion process over historical and future trajectory segments and annealed history guidance to produce temporally consistent motion plans.
tldr_zh: 提出扩散强制规划器（DFP），用于自动驾驶，通过对历史和未来轨迹片段进行异质联合扩散并使用退火历史引导，生成时间一致的运动规划。
summary_zh: 基于学习的运动规划器尽管近期取得进展，但常存在时间不一致性问题。帧间的微小扰动会累积成不稳定的轨迹，从而降低闭环驾驶的舒适性与安全性。部分方法尝试将历史信息作为静态条件信号注入以稳定输出，却导致规划器倾向于复制历史模式而非适应环境上下文。为解决此局限，我们提出扩散强制规划器（DFP）——一种由历史引导控制驱动的扩散式规划框架。具体而言，DFP将完整轨迹分解为历史段、当前段与未来段，并为各段分配独立噪声水平。该模型对历史段与未来段进行联合去噪，实现异质联合扩散过程。推理阶段，应用无分类器引导（CFG）以可控方式利用退火历史引导未来采样。在nuPlan上的闭环评估与全面消融实验表明，DFP在复杂驾驶场景中能在保持竞争性能的同时生成连续、稳定且可控的运动规划。

title: Language-Driven Cost Optimization for Autonomous Driving
summary: The driving behavior of autonomous vehicles is typically governed by the cost function of their motion planner, which encodes objectives such as speed tracking, smoothness, lane keeping, and collision avoidance. However, tuning the parameters that shape this cost function is a challenging task that requires technical expertise, limiting the vehicle's ability to adapt to evolving traffic scenarios or end-user preferences. This work presents a language-driven framework for adaptive cost design in autonomous driving. A Large Language Model (LLM) interprets structured scenario descriptions and natural language user queries to generate the parameters applied to a risk-aware Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) controller. The system incorporates a human-in-the-loop validation stage in which the proposed behavioral changes are described in non-technical language and confirmed prior to deployment. Users may additionally provide feedback either before or after deployment, enabling iterative refinement of the vehicle's motion behavior. The framework is evaluated across multiple queries in realistic driving scenarios to assess its effectiveness. Simulation results demonstrate that the method successfully induces behavioral changes that align with the intended requirements in an intuitive manner, thereby bridging the gap between intelligent vehicle control systems and end users.
tldr: A framework that uses an LLM to generate cost function parameters for a Model Predictive Path Integral controller from natural language, enabling intuitive behavioral tuning for autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: 一个利用大语言模型根据自然语言生成模型预测路径积分控制器成本函数参数的框架，实现自动驾驶行为的直观调优。
summary_zh: 自动驾驶车辆的驾驶行为通常由其运动规划器的成本函数决定，该函数编码了速度跟踪、平顺性、车道保持及碰撞规避等目标。然而，调整构成该成本函数的参数是一项需要专业技术知识的挑战性任务，这限制了车辆适应不断变化的交通场景或最终用户偏好的能力。本文提出了一种面向自动驾驶的自适应成本设计语言驱动框架。大语言模型通过解析结构化场景描述与自然语言用户查询，生成应用于风险感知型模型预测路径积分控制器的参数。该系统引入人机协同验证阶段，在此阶段中，拟定的行为变更将以非技术性语言进行描述，并在实施前获得确认。用户可在部署前后提供反馈，从而实现车辆运动行为的迭代优化。该框架在真实驾驶场景中通过多项查询进行了有效性评估。仿真结果表明，该方法能直观地诱导出符合预期需求的行为变化，从而弥合智能车辆控制系统与最终用户之间的鸿沟。

title: Task Robustness via Re-Labelling Vision-Action Robot Data
summary: The recent trend in scaling models for robot learning has resulted in impressive policies that can perform various manipulation tasks and generalize to novel scenarios. However, these policies continue to struggle with following instructions, likely due to the limited linguistic and action sequence diversity in existing robotics datasets. This paper introduces Task Robustness via Re-Labelling Vision-Action Robot Data (TREAD), a scalable framework that leverages large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to augment existing robotics datasets without additional data collection, harnessing the transferable knowledge embedded in these models. Our approach leverages a pretrained VLM through three stages: generating semantic sub-tasks from original instruction labels and initial scenes, segmenting demonstration videos conditioned on these sub-tasks, and producing diverse instructions that incorporate object properties, effectively decomposing longer demonstrations into grounded language-action pairs. We further enhance robustness by augmenting the data with linguistically diverse versions of the text goals. Evaluations on LIBERO demonstrate that policies trained on our augmented datasets exhibit improved performance on novel, unseen tasks and goals. Our results show that TREAD enhances both planning generalization through trajectory decomposition and language-conditioned policy generalization through increased linguistic diversity.
tldr: TREAD uses VLMs to automatically re-label robot manipulation datasets with diverse, grounded instructions and sub-task decompositions, improving policy generalization on unseen tasks like LIBERO benchmarks.
tldr_zh: TREAD利用大视觉语言模型自动对机器人操作数据集进行重新标注，生成多样化的指令和子任务分解，从而提升策略在未见任务上的泛化能力（如在LIBERO基准上的表现）。
summary_zh: 近期，通过扩展模型规模推动机器人学习发展的趋势已催生出令人瞩目的策略，这些策略能够执行多种操作任务并泛化至新场景。然而，此类策略在遵循指令方面仍存在困难，这很可能源于现有机器人数据集中语言与动作序列多样性的不足。本文提出"通过重新标注视觉-动作机器人数据实现任务鲁棒性"（TREAD）框架，该可扩展方法利用大型视觉-语言模型（VLM）在不额外采集数据的前提下增强现有机器人数据集，充分挖掘这些模型内嵌的可迁移知识。我们的方法通过三个阶段运用预训练VLM：从原始指令标签和初始场景生成语义子任务、根据这些子任务对演示视频进行分段、生成融合物体属性的多样化指令，从而将较长演示有效分解为情境化的语言-动作配对。我们进一步通过为文本目标添加语言多样性版本的数据增强手段来提升鲁棒性。在LIBERO基准上的评估表明，基于增强数据集训练的策略在应对新颖、未见任务与目标时展现出更优性能。实验结果显示，TREAD通过轨迹分解增强了规划泛化能力，并通过提升语言多样性增强了语言条件策略的泛化能力。

title: AgniNav: Configuration-Driven Cross-Embodiment Local Planning for Robot Navigation
summary: Monocular local navigation is attractive for lightweight robots, but existing vision-based policies often couple perception to a specific body, camera height, and footprint, making transfer from wheeled bases to legged platforms dependent on retraining or active depth hardware. This paper introduces AgniNav, a configuration-driven local navigation framework that standardizes cross-embodiment transfer at the collision-envelope level. Each robot is specified by a measurable four-parameter safety envelope: collision-relevant height, front length, rear length, and half width. The height parameter conditions an image-to-scan network to predict a one-dimensional, collision-relevant pseudo-laserscan from a monocular color image, while the remaining footprint parameters configure a dimension-aware local planner for collision checking. Training uses height-conditioned column-minimum scan labels generated from paired color-depth data, allowing the same image to supervise different safety envelopes without collecting robot-specific data. To the best of our knowledge, AgniNav is the first monocular local-navigation framework that jointly conditions perception and planning on a shared collision-envelope configuration for zero-retraining deployment across wheeled, quadruped, and humanoid platforms. Real-robot experiments on a Turtlebot2, Unitree Go2, and Accelerated Evolution K1 achieve 39/40, 18/20, and 18/20 successes with 0/40, 1/20, and 2/20 collisions, respectively, while running at 30 Hz on Jetson Orin.
tldr: AgniNav introduces a configuration-driven local navigation framework that enables zero-retraining cross-embodiment deployment by conditioning both perception and planning on a shared four-parameter safety envelope, validated on wheeled, quadruped, and humanoid robots.
tldr_zh: AgniNav 提出了一个配置驱动的局部导航框架，通过在共享的四参数安全包络上同时调节感知和规划，实现了无需重新训练的跨形态部署，并在轮式、四足和类人机器人上得到验证。
summary_zh: 单目局部导航对轻量级机器人具有吸引力，但现有基于视觉的策略通常将感知与特定本体、相机高度和足迹绑定，导致从轮式底盘向足式平台的迁移依赖重新训练或主动深度硬件。本文提出AgniNav，一种以碰撞包络层面标准化跨本体迁移的配置驱动型局部导航框架。每个机器人由可测量的四参数安全包络定义：碰撞相关高度、前部长度、后部长度和半宽度。高度参数驱动图像到扫描网络的预测，从单目彩色图像生成一维碰撞相关伪激光扫描，而剩余足迹参数配置维度感知局部规划器进行碰撞检测。训练使用配对彩色-深度数据生成的高度条件化列极小扫描标签，使同一张图像可监督不同安全包络，无需采集机器人特定数据。据我们所知，AgniNav是首个在共享碰撞包络配置上联合条件化感知与规划的单目局部导航框架，可实现跨轮式、四足和人形平台的零重新训练部署。在Turtlebot2、Unitree Go2和Accelerated Evolution K1上的真实机器人实验中，分别实现39/40、18/20和18/20的成功率，碰撞次数为0/40、1/20和2/20，运行频率为30 Hz（基于Jetson Orin平台）。

title: MV-Actor: Aligning Multi-View Semantics and Spatial Awareness for Bimanual Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation has been widely applied in industrial scenarios. Compared with single-arm manipulation, bimanual manipulation is equipped with multiple cameras to capture information from different viewpoints. However, existing multi-view policies encode each view independently or fuse view features shallowly, resulting in limited sharing semantic perception and unreliable spatial awareness. In this paper, we propose \textbf{MV-Actor}, a multi-view perception framework that builds a unified semantic-spatial representation for bimanual manipulation. First, MV-Actor performs Multi-view Semantic Interaction to share semantic perception across views. Then it uses Semantic-Spatial Token Interaction to ground visual semantics with feed-forward reconstruction model features and acquire reliable spatial awareness. Finally, a Guided Metric Depth Repair module refines degraded sensor depth to provide more reliable metric anchors under consumer-grade depth noise. In simulation experiments conducted on the PerAct2 bimanual benchmark, MV-Actor achieves a state-of-the-art average success rate of 87.8\%. In real-world evaluations with more frequent viewpoint changes and unstable consumer-grade depth, MV-Actor outperforms both RGB and RGB-D baselines, further demonstrating the benefit of sharing semantic perception and reliable spatial awareness for bimanual manipulation.
tldr: MV-Actor introduces a multi-view perception framework with unified semantic-spatial representation and guided metric depth repair for bimanual manipulation, achieving state-of-the-art success rates on the PerAct2 benchmark and in real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: MV-Actor 提出了一种统一语义-空间表示的多视角感知框架，并配有引导式度量深度修复模块，用于双臂操作，在 PerAct2 基准和真实世界实验中取得了最佳成功率。
summary_zh: 机器人操作已在工业场景中得到广泛应用。与单臂操作相比，双臂操作配备了多个摄像头，可从不同视角捕捉信息。然而，现有的多视角策略要么独立编码每个视角，要么仅对视角特征进行浅层融合，导致语义感知共享受限且空间感知不可靠。本文提出 **MV-Actor**，一种为双臂操作构建统一语义-空间表征的多视角感知框架。首先，MV-Actor 通过多视角语义交互实现跨视角的语义感知共享；随后，利用语义-空间令牌交互将视觉语义与前馈重建模型特征相结合，获取可靠的空间感知；最后，引导式度量深度修复模块能修复退化的传感器深度，在消费级深度噪声下提供更可靠的度量锚点。在 PerAct2 双臂基准的仿真实验中，MV-Actor 达到了 87.8% 的平均成功率，为当前最优水平。在视角变化更频繁、消费级深度不稳定的真实场景评估中，MV-Actor 优于 RGB 和 RGB-D 基线方法，进一步证明了共享语义感知与可靠空间感知对双臂操作的益处。

title: Bridging Semantics and Physical Execution: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Multi-Pair Robotic Assembly
summary: Multi-pair robotic assembly in unstructured environments faces spatial interference and contact uncertainties. Existing paradigms fail to bridge cognitive decision-making and physical execution, as they either encounter state-space explosion and knowledge bottlenecks or suffer from logical hallucinations and topological conflicts. We propose an end-to-end neuro-symbolic framework that solves the challenge hierarchically: generating optimal subgraphs for each pair, decoupling generality from edge cases, and then resolving cross-pair interferences. Given an eye-on-hand RGB-D assembly scene, the framework extracts semantic instance identity and state while quantifying the scene for divergence calculation. For each pair, optimal subgraph is generated via LLM using barely basic actions to mitigate hallucinations. Supportive actions for edge cases are reasoned and inserted with a lightweight discriminator. Driven by the divergence between the quantified baseline and current scene, it is easily extensible at low cost. Augmented subgraphs are topologically coordinated into global sequences while preserving internal behavioral coherence. Dynamic behavior trees embedding atomic skills close the force-aware execution loop. Offline evaluation on 100 real-world scenes achieves 97.00% global executability, outperforming classical and state-of-the-art planners. Real-robot deployment on a UR3 arm attains 90% success rate with 0.5 mm tolerance under strong interference, demonstrating a unified and verifiable solution for complex autonomous assembly.
tldr: This paper proposes a neuro-symbolic framework for multi-pair robotic assembly that uses LLMs for subgraph generation and dynamic behavior trees for execution, achieving high success rates on real robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种神经符号框架用于多对机器人装配，利用LLM生成子图并结合动态行为树执行，在真实机器人上实现了高成功率。

title: Hand-centric Human-to-Robot Trajectory Transfer from Video Demonstrations via Open-World Contact Localization
summary: Learning from human video demonstrations remains challenging due to noisy hand-object interactions, unseen objects with partial observation, and cross-embodiment discrepancy. To address these challenges, we present \textit{HOWTransfer} (\emph{H}and-\emph{O}bject \emph{O}pen-\emph{W}orld Transfer), a hand-centric framework that distills human demonstrations into contact-aware, taxonomy-informed, and diverse robotic trajectories. Instead of relying on object-specific descriptions, vision-language queries, or explicit object-state tracking, \emph{HOWTransfer} recovers temporally consistent 3D hand motion and localizes temporal contact intervals by reasoning over observed hand-object interaction cues. The localized contact onsets are then used to retarget human grasp intent into multi-modal parallel-jaw grasp hypotheses, which are propagated along the recovered wrist trajectory to generate robot-executable motions. Finally, a trajectory editing stage refines contact alignment and produces diverse executable variants from a single demonstration. Experiments across diverse manipulation tasks show that \emph{HOWTransfer} enables accurate contact localization and high-quality robot motion retargeting with $86\%$ success, which is preferred over teleoperated trajectories in a blinded preference study.
tldr: HOWTransfer extracts contact-aware robotic trajectories from human video demonstrations by localizing hand-object contact onsets and retargeting grasp intent into diverse parallel-jaw grasp hypotheses, achieving 86% success on real robot tasks.
tldr_zh: HOWTransfer通过定位手-物体接触时刻并将抓取意图重定向到多种平行爪抓取假设，从人类视频演示中提取接触感知的机器人轨迹，在真实机器人任务上实现了86%的成功率。
summary_zh: 从人类视频演示中学习仍具有挑战性，原因在于嘈杂的手-物交互、部分观测下的未见物体以及跨形态差异。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 \textit{HOWTransfer}（\emph{手-物开放世界迁移}），这是一种以手部为中心的框架，可将人类演示蒸馏为接触感知、分类学引导且多样化的机器人轨迹。\emph{HOWTransfer} 不依赖于物体特定的描述、视觉语言查询或显式的物体状态追踪，而是通过推理观测到的手-物交互线索，恢复时间一致的三维手部运动并定位时域接触区间。随后，利用定位到的接触起始时间点将人类抓取意图重映射为多模态平行夹爪抓取假设，这些假设沿恢复的手腕轨迹传播以生成机器人可执行的运动。最后，轨迹编辑阶段精细调整接触对齐，并从单次演示中生成多样化的可执行变体。在多种操作任务上的实验表明，\emph{HOWTransfer} 能够实现精确的接触定位与高质量的机器人运动重映射，成功率达到 86\%，且在盲选偏好研究中比遥操作轨迹更受青睐。

title: Vehicle Prediction Model for Enhanced MPC Path Tracking in Formula Student Driverless
summary: Autonomous race cars, such as in Formula Student Driverless, operate close to their physical handling limits. The resulting highly nonlinear vehicle behavior increases the path tracking complexity, especially on narrow tracks. Model Predictive Control (MPC) is commonly used to address this issue, a method whose performance is closely tied to the accuracy of the underlying prediction model. This paper presents a novel, real-time capable prediction model for autonomous race cars that adjusts to changing conditions by combining information from past runs and the current driving situation. Our model is divided into three consecutive submodels: a nominal Kinematic Bicycle Model, an offline Bayesian Linear Regression (BLR) model, and an online Sparse Gaussian Process Regression (SGPR) model. The proposed approach enables efficient integration of all available data without significantly increasing computational cost, ensuring high prediction accuracy and a quantitative uncertainty assessment right from the start of the run. Compared to existing approaches, an improvement in prediction accuracy of up to 57% was achieved. Further, we successfully demonstrated the practical applicability of the model within an MPC-based path tracking controller on a real Formula Student race car.
tldr: This paper proposes a real-time vehicle prediction model combining a kinematic bicycle model, offline Bayesian linear regression, and online sparse Gaussian process regression to improve MPC-based path tracking for autonomous race cars, achieving up to 57% better prediction accuracy and demonstrating deployment on a real Formula Student car.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种实时车辆预测模型，结合运动学自行车模型、离线贝叶斯线性回归和在线稀疏高斯过程回归，以提升自动驾驶赛车的MPC路径跟踪性能，预测精度最高提升57%，并在真实赛车上验证。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
自动驾驶赛车（如大学生方程式无人驾驶项目中的赛车）在接近物理操控极限的状态下运行。由此产生的高度非线性车辆行为增加了路径跟踪的复杂性，尤其是在狭窄赛道上。模型预测控制（MPC）常被用于解决该问题，其性能与底层预测模型的精度密切相关。本文提出了一种适用于自动驾驶赛车的新型实时预测模型，该模型通过融合历史运行数据与当前驾驶情境，能够适应动态变化的工况。该模型由三个连续的子模型构成：名义运动学自行车模型、离线贝叶斯线性回归（BLR）模型以及在线稀疏高斯过程回归（SGPR）模型。所提方法可在不显著增加计算成本的前提下高效整合所有可用数据，从而在运行初始阶段即实现高精度预测与定量不确定性评估。与现有方法相比，预测精度最高提升了57%。此外，我们还在真实的大学生方程式赛车上，成功验证了该模型在基于MPC的路径跟踪控制器中的实际应用可行性。

title: Self-Supervised Relevance Modelling in Autonomous Driving via Counterfactual Analysis
summary: Autonomous driving relies on computationally intensive perception pipelines to continuously detect and track objects in the surrounding environment. While some objects are key to plan safe and effective maneuvers, others may not be relevant and have no impact on the autonomous vehicle's driving decisions. Focusing on relevant objects allows a more efficient usage of available computational resources, reduces processing latencies, and limits the downstream propagation of perception noise. In this work, we propose a novel self-supervised approach based on counterfactual analysis to develop a relevance model - an AI-based tool that quantifies the relevance of objects for an autonomous vehicle. To demonstrate the potential of the proposed approach, we train a relevance model on a synthetic causal dataset generated in a selected urban scenario. Results show that the relevance model is able to accurately estimate the objects' relevance with millisecond-level latency, enabling real-time relevance estimation also in high-density scenarios. We also show that the relevance model can be used to build relevance heatmaps that offer valuable insights into the autonomous vehicle's driving policy and can be used to proactively inform perception and planning tasks. We openly release both the relevance model and the causal dataset.
tldr: Proposes a self-supervised counterfactual approach to train a relevance model that identifies which objects matter for autonomous driving decisions, enabling real-time filtering and heatmap-based policy insights.
tldr_zh: 提出一种基于反事实分析的自监督方法，训练相关性模型来识别对自动驾驶决策重要的物体，实现实时过滤和策略热图可视化。
summary_zh: 自动驾驶依赖于计算密集型的感知流水线，以持续检测和跟踪周围环境中的物体。某些物体对于规划安全有效的驾驶操作至关重要，而另一些物体则可能无关紧要，对自动驾驶车辆的驾驶决策没有影响。聚焦于相关物体可以更高效地利用可用计算资源，降低处理延迟，并限制感知噪声的下游传播。在本工作中，我们提出了一种基于反事实分析的新型自监督方法，用于开发相关性模型——一种基于人工智能的工具，能够量化物体对自动驾驶车辆的相关性。为了展示所提出方法的潜力，我们在选定城区场景生成的合成因果数据集上训练了一个相关性模型。结果表明，该相关性模型能够以毫秒级延迟准确估计物体的相关性，从而在高密度场景中也能实现实时相关性估计。我们还展示了该模型可用于构建相关性热力图，为自动驾驶车辆的驾驶策略提供有价值的见解，并可用于主动指导感知与规划任务。我们公开发布了该相关性模型及因果数据集。

title: Dexterous Point Policy: Learning Point-based Dexterous Hand Policies from Human Demonstrations
summary: Robotic foundation models pre-trained on human demonstration videos have shown promise, but a significant embodiment gap remains when the resulting policies are deployed on real robots. A common remedy is to fine-tune these models on robot-specific demonstrations. However, robot data collection can be prohibitively expensive and time-consuming, which is particularly acute in dexterous manipulation, e.g., teleoperating a multi-fingered hand for even a single atomic task can take days. To address this, we introduce Dexterous Point Policy, a framework that learns dexterous manipulation policies directly from human videos and requires no robot demonstrations. Our core insight is that a unified 3D keypoint representation can bridge human and robot embodiments when used for both observations and actions. Specifically, we extract 3D keypoints of task-relevant objects and human hands from raw videos, and train an autoregressive transformer over these keypoints. We observe that at the keypoint level, specifically the wrist and fingertips, human and robot behaviors closely align, enabling direct policy transfer. On a suite of real-robot tasks spanning pick-and-place and tool use, Dexterous Point Policy attains 75.0% success, whereas a state-of-the-art VLA baseline reaches only 1.0%. Furthermore, our method generalizes strongly to unseen scenarios, including multi-object environments and novel object categories.
tldr: Dexterous Point Policy learns dexterous manipulation policies directly from human videos by using a unified 3D keypoint representation for both observations and actions, eliminating the need for robot demonstrations.
tldr_zh: Dexterous Point Policy 通过使用统一的 3D 关键点表示来同时处理观测和动作，直接从人类视频学习灵巧操作策略，无需机器人演示。
summary_zh: 基于人类演示视频预训练的机器人基础模型已展现出潜力，但当所得策略部署至真实机器人时，仍存在显著的具身鸿沟。常见的解决方法是利用机器人专用演示数据对这些模型进行微调。然而，机器人数据采集成本高昂且耗时，在灵巧操作领域尤为突出——例如，仅通过遥操作多指手完成单个原子任务就需耗时数日。针对这一问题，我们提出"灵巧点策略"（Dexterous Point Policy），该框架可直接从人类视频中学习灵巧操作策略，无需依赖机器人演示数据。我们的核心洞见在于：统一的三维关键点表示在同时用于观测与动作时，能够弥合人类与机器人具身形态的差异。具体而言，我们从原始视频中提取任务相关物体与人类手部的三维关键点，并基于这些关键点训练自回归Transformer模型。我们观察到，在关键点层面（特别是腕关节与指尖），人类与机器人的行为高度一致，从而实现了策略的直接迁移。在涵盖抓取-放置与工具使用的一系列真实机器人任务中，灵巧点策略达到了75.0%的成功率，而当前最先进的VLA基线方法仅达1.0%。此外，该方法对未见过的场景表现出强大的泛化能力，包括多物体环境及新型物体类别。

title: VeriSpace: Spatially Grounded Action Verification for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong promise for robotic manipulation, but their reliability at test time remains limited by one-shot action prediction, where even small action errors can cause grasp failure, collision, or incorrect task progression. A natural alternative is to equip VLA systems with test-time verification, allowing multiple candidate actions to be proposed and evaluated before execution. However, reliable action verification is challenging because it requires not only distinguishing subtle geometric differences between candidate actions, but also assessing whether an action makes meaningful progress toward the task goal. We present VeriSpace, a 3D-aware action verifier for test-time action selection in VLA systems. VeriSpace evaluates candidate actions through two key components: Dual-Path 3D-Injected Scene Encoding, which constructs a scene representation that jointly preserves visual semantics and explicit 3D geometry, and Spatially-Grounded Action Reasoning, which evaluates each action by reasoning over task-relevant spatial relations, geometric validity, and expected goal progress. Together, these components enable more reliable discrimination between subtle yet outcome-critical action candidates while remaining fully compatible with existing VLA policies. Experiments on public benchmarks and real-world robotic manipulation tasks show that VeriSpace consistently improves decision reliability over both underlying VLA policies and prior verification-based methods, yielding substantial gains in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings.
tldr: VeriSpace introduces a 3D-aware action verifier that evaluates candidate actions for VLA models using spatially grounded reasoning, improving manipulation reliability in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings.
tldr_zh: VeriSpace提出了一种3D感知的动作验证器，通过空间基础推理评估候选动作，提升了VLA模型在分布内和分布外场景中的操作可靠性。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作任务中展现出巨大潜力，但其测试时的可靠性仍受限于单步动作预测——即便是微小的动作误差也可能导致抓取失败、碰撞或任务进程错误。一种自然的改进方案是为VLA系统配备测试时验证机制，使其能在执行前提出并评估多个候选动作。然而，可靠的动作验证极具挑战性，因为这不仅需要区分候选动作间细微的几何差异，还需评估该动作是否能有效推动任务目标的实现。我们提出VeriSpace——一种面向VLA系统测试时动作选择的3D感知动作验证器。VeriSpace通过两个核心组件评估候选动作：双路径3D注入场景编码模块，该模块构建同时保留视觉语义与显式3D几何信息的场景表征；以及空间锚定动作推理模块，该模块通过推理任务相关的空间关系、几何有效性及预期目标进展来评估每个动作。这些组件共同实现了对细微但影响结果的关键候选动作的更可靠区分，同时保持与现有VLA策略的完全兼容性。在公开基准测试与真实机器人操作任务上的实验表明，VeriSpace在分布内与分布外场景下均能持续提升基础VLA策略及先前基于验证的方法的决策可靠性。

title: Act on What You See: Unlocking Safe Social Navigation in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Safe social navigation requires robots to distinguish people from ordinary obstacles and to react before danger becomes imminent. We show that pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models already encode pedestrian-object distinctions and future collision signals in their internal representations, but behavior cloning fails to translate these signals into socially appropriate actions. To address this mismatch, we propose SALSA, a two-stage annotation-free post-training framework: (1) social behavioral alignment bridges intermediate-layer social features to the action head and trains on counterfactual human-object scene pairs to break visual saliency shortcuts; (2) temporal safety alignment provides automatically generated future-risk supervision to enable anticipatory collision avoidance. On SCAND and real-world deployment, SALSA reduces near-collisions by 86.4% and improves social counterfactual accuracy from 53% to 93%, demonstrating that safer social navigation can be achieved by teaching VLA policies to act on representations they already possess. These results show that pretrained VLA policies can be adapted for safer social navigation by better aligning their latent representations with action generation.
tldr: SALSA adapts pretrained VLA models for safer social navigation via two annotation-free post-training stages: social behavioral alignment and temporal safety alignment, drastically reducing near-collisions.
tldr_zh: SALSA通过两阶段无标注后训练——社会行为对齐和时间安全对齐——将预训练VLA模型适配到更安全的社交导航，大幅减少近碰撞事故。
summary_zh: 安全的社交导航要求机器人能够将行人区分于普通障碍物，并在危险迫近前做出反应。研究表明，预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已在其内部表征中编码了行人-物体区分信息及未来碰撞信号，但行为克隆无法将这些信号转化为符合社交规范的行动。为解决这一不匹配问题，我们提出SALSA——一种无需标注的两阶段后训练框架：（1）社交行为对齐将中间层社交特征桥接至动作头，并通过反事实人-物场景对进行训练，以打破视觉显著性捷径；（2）时序安全对齐提供自动生成的未来风险监督，实现预测性碰撞规避。在SCAND基准及真实场景部署中，SALSA将近碰撞事件减少86.4%，社交反事实准确率从53%提升至93%，证明通过引导VLA策略利用其已具备的表征进行行动决策，可实现更安全的社交导航。这些结果表明，通过更有效地将潜在表征与动作生成对齐，预训练VLA策略可被适配用于更安全的社交导航。

title: GuideWalk: Learning Unified Autonomous Navigation and Locomotion for Humanoid Robots across Versatile Terrains
summary: Humanoid robots have achieved strong locomotion capabilities, but reliable navigation on versatile terrains remains challenging because obstacle avoidance must be coordinated with dynamically feasible motion. In this work, we present GuideWalk, a unified end-to-end framework that integrates traversability-aware navigation guidance with terrain-adaptive locomotion teacher for humanoid navigation. Specifically, we introduce a navigation module that provides explicit velocity guidance, decoupling obstacle avoidance from terrain conditions to enable robust planning across diverse environments. We propose a composite teacher distillation scheme, where goal-directed commands and dynamically consistent actions are aggregated and distilled into a single policy. To further improve robustness, the distilled policy is refined with reinforcement learning and an auxiliary behavior cloning objective, which promotes exploration while preserving desirable teacher behaviors. Experiments demonstrate that GuideWalk achieves stable and effective navigation while maintaining stable humanoid locomotion.
tldr: GuideWalk presents a unified framework for humanoid robot navigation that integrates traversability-aware guidance with terrain-adaptive locomotion through a composite teacher distillation scheme.
tldr_zh: GuideWalk 提出了一个统一的人形机器人导航框架，通过复合教师蒸馏方案整合了可穿越性感知导航与地形自适应运动。
summary_zh: 人形机器人已具备强大的运动能力，但在多变地形上的可靠导航仍具挑战性，因为避障需与动态可行的运动相协调。本研究提出GuideWalk——一种统一端到端框架，将可通行性感知的导航引导与地形自适应运动教师策略相结合，用于人形机器人导航。具体而言，我们引入了一个提供显式速度引导的导航模块，将避障与地形条件解耦，从而实现在多样环境中的鲁棒规划。我们提出了一种复合教师蒸馏方案，将目标导向指令与动态一致动作聚合后蒸馏至单一策略。为进一步提升鲁棒性，蒸馏策略通过强化学习与辅助行为克隆目标进行精炼，在保留理想教师行为的同时促进探索。实验表明，GuideWalk能在保持稳定人形运动的前提下实现稳定有效的导航。

title: UMI-Bench 1.0: An Open and Reproducible Real-World Benchmark for Tabletop Robotic Manipulation with UMI Data
summary: Real-robot evaluation is essential for understanding whether learned manipulation policies can operate reliably outside curated demonstrations. This need is particularly pressing for Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI)-style policies, whose performance depends on the coupling between wrist-view observations, action representation, data collection, and physical deployment. Existing real-world benchmarks have made important progress, but they are not designed around this UMI data-to-deployment setting. We present UMI-Bench 1.0, a local-first real-robot benchmark for standardized evaluation of UMI-style manipulation policies. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first benchmark dedicated to real-world evaluation of UMI-based manipulation models. UMI-Bench aligns data collection, scene reset, policy execution, result logging, and task-factor analysis within a unified protocol. By making the full evaluation process reproducible and auditable, UMI-Bench provides a practical testbed for measuring how UMI-trained policies generalize to real physical manipulation.
tldr: UMI-Bench 1.0 is the first open, reproducible real-world benchmark dedicated to evaluating UMI-style tabletop manipulation policies, integrating data collection, scene reset, execution, and logging into a unified protocol.
tldr_zh: UMI-Bench 1.0 是首个专为评估UMI风格桌面操作策略而设计的开放、可复现的真实世界基准，将数据收集、场景重置、执行和日志记录统一到一个协议中。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
真实机器人评估对于理解学习到的操作策略能否在精心编排的演示之外稳定运行至关重要。这一需求对通用操作接口（UMI）类策略尤为迫切，因为其性能依赖于腕部视角观测、动作表示、数据收集与物理部署之间的耦合。现有真实世界基准已取得重要进展，但并非围绕这种UMI“从数据到部署”的设定而设计。我们提出了UMI-Bench 1.0，一个面向本地的真实机器人基准，用于标准化评估UMI类操作策略。据我们所知，这是首个专用于基于UMI的操作模型真实世界评估的基准。UMI-Bench将数据收集、场景重置、策略执行、结果记录和任务因素分析统一纳入一个标准化协议中。通过使整个评估过程可复现且可审计，UMI-Bench为衡量UMI训练策略向真实物理操作的泛化能力提供了一个实用的测试平台。

title: Test-time Adversarial Takeover: A Real-time Hijacking Interface against Robotic Diffusion Policies
summary: Diffusion-based action generation has become a foundational component of embodied AI, but its reliance on visual conditioning leaves deployed visuomotor policies vulnerable to adversarial manipulation. Most prior attacks focus on disruption: they perturb the observation stream to reduce task success or induce erratic behavior. We study a stronger threat, Test-time Adversarial Takeover (TAKO), in which an attacker obtains a real-time steering interface over a frozen robot policy and turns it into a remotely piloted instrument. TAKO learns a small vocabulary of reusable universal patches through differentiable diffusion inference; at test time, the attacker switches among these patches in the camera stream to compose attacker-chosen trajectories. This works because the perturbation acts on the visual conditioning pathway, where the induced bias can persist through iterative generative inference. We further show that the natural targeted baseline, target-policy matching, fails because the victim policy cannot reliably supervise itself on out-of-distribution target shifts. Across four tasks (2D manipulation, simulated aerial delivery, simulated ground navigation, and physical-world ground navigation), two visual encoders (ResNet-18 and EfficientNet-B0 + Transformer), and three generative inference families (DDPM, DDIM, and flow matching), human operators achieve 100\% takeover success on attacker-defined objectives in every evaluated setting. The project page is available at https://tako-attack.github.io.
tldr: This paper introduces TAKO, a real-time adversarial attack that hijacks diffusion-based robot policies by learning reusable visual patches, achieving 100% takeover success across multiple tasks and settings.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了TAKO，一种实时对抗攻击方法，通过学习可复用的视觉补丁来劫持基于扩散的机器人策略，在多个任务和场景中实现了100%的接管成功率。
summary_zh: 基于扩散的动作生成已成为具身智能的基础组件，但其对视觉条件设定的依赖使得部署的视觉运动策略容易受到对抗性操控。已有的大多数攻击侧重于干扰：它们扰动观测流以降低任务成功率或引发异常行为。本研究探讨一种更强的威胁——测试时对抗性接管（TAKO），攻击者通过冻结的机器人策略获得实时操控接口，将其转变为远程操控工具。TAKO通过可微扩散推理学习由少量可重复使用的通用补丁构成的词汇表；在测试时，攻击者在相机流中切换这些补丁，以组合成攻击者选择的轨迹。该攻击之所以有效，是因为扰动作用于视觉条件设定路径，由此引发的偏差能通过迭代生成推理持续存在。我们进一步证明，自然的针对性基线方法——目标策略匹配——之所以失效，是因为受害者策略无法在分布外目标偏移下可靠地进行自我监督。在四项任务（二维操控、模拟空中投递、模拟地面导航及物理世界地面导航）、两种视觉编码器（ResNet-18与EfficientNet-B0+Transformer）以及三种生成推理框架（DDPM、DDIM与流匹配）中，人类操作员在所有评估场景下均实现了100%的攻击者定义目标接管成功率。项目页面可访问https://tako-attack.github.io。

title: HiMem-WAM: Hierarchical Memory-Gated World Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a new powerful paradigm for embodied intelligence, learning action-relevant visual dynamics that significantly enhance generalization and robustness. However, existing WAMs still struggle with task-relevant memory in long-horizon robotic manipulation. To address this, we present HiMem-WAM, a Hierarchical Memory-Gated WAM that integrates motion-centric latent actions, high-level skill latents, and boundary-triggered memory updates. Specifically, we develop a hierarchical latent action framework that jointly learns low-level motion and high-level skill latents, providing structured temporal abstraction. Meanwhile, a boundary-aware memory gate writes compact task states at predicted skill transitions, enabling causal inference without test-time generation of future video or optical flow estimation. Evaluated on LIBERO, LIBERO-PLUS, RMBench and real-world tasks, HiMem-WAM shows that hierarchical latents improve robustness under deployment perturbations, and the memory module substantially benefits memory-dependent long-horizon manipulation.
tldr: HiMem-WAM proposes a hierarchical memory-gated world action model that learns motion and skill latents with boundary-triggered memory updates to improve long-horizon robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: HiMem-WAM 提出了一种分层记忆门控世界动作模型，通过学习运动与技能隐变量以及边界触发的记忆更新，提升长时域机器人操作性能。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）已成为具身智能领域一种强大的新范式，通过学习与动作相关的视觉动态，显著提升了泛化能力与鲁棒性。然而，现有WAMs在长时程机器人操作中仍面临任务相关记忆的挑战。为此，我们提出HiMem-WAM——一种层级记忆门控世界模型，其整合了以运动为中心的潜在动作、高层技能潜在表示及边界触发的记忆更新机制。具体而言，我们构建了层级潜在动作框架，联合学习底层运动与高层技能潜在表示，从而实现结构化的时间抽象。同时，边界感知记忆门控机制在预测的技能转换节点写入紧凑任务状态，在无需测试时生成未来视频或光流估计的前提下支持因果推理。在LIBERO、LIBERO-PLUS、RMBench及真实世界任务上的评估表明，HiMem-WAM的层级潜在表示提升了部署扰动下的鲁棒性，其记忆模块则显著改善了依赖记忆的长时程操作任务。

title: OMG: Omni-Modal Motion Generation for Generalist Humanoid Control
summary: Humanoid whole-body control has made significant progress in recent years, yet existing approaches remain limited to few-skill policies with heavy reward engineering, or motion trackers that are difficult to extend to new input modalities. We argue that the key to general-purpose humanoid control is to build a scalable brain, a module capable of reasoning with diverse conditioning modalities, atop a reactive motion tracking cerebellum, mirroring the hierarchical structure of biological motor systems. Two challenges arise in realizing this vision: acquiring a vast amount of high-quality data to achieve general purpose control, and equipping the generator with the capability to condition on compositional, extensible multi-modal inputs. We present OMG, which addresses these challenges with a meticulous data curation, filtering and labeling pipeline, as well as a diffusion-based motion generation backbone that conditions on language, audio, and human reference motions. Extensive experiments validate OMG as an omni-modal whole-body controller exhibiting state-of-the-art performance, model scaling behavior and efficient adaptation to new distributions and modalities, marking a concrete step toward foundation models for humanoid robots.
tldr: OMG proposes a scalable, diffusion-based whole-body motion generation system for humanoid robots that conditions on language, audio, and reference motions, supported by a rigorous data pipeline, enabling generalist omni-modal control.
tldr_zh: OMG提出了一种可扩展的、基于扩散的全身运动生成系统，用于人形机器人，该系统以语言、音频和参考动作为条件，并辅以严格的数据流水线，从而实现通用的全模态控制。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
近年来，仿人全身控制取得了显著进展，但现有方法仍局限于依赖密集奖励设计的少数技能策略，或难以扩展至新型输入模态的运动追踪器。我们认为，通用仿人控制的关键在于构建一个可扩展的“大脑”——一个能够处理多样化条件模态的模块，并将其置于反应式运动追踪“小脑”之上，以此镜像生物运动系统的层级结构。实现这一愿景面临两大挑战：获取海量高质量数据以实现通用控制，以及赋予生成器处理组合式、可扩展多模态输入的能力。为此，我们提出OMG系统，通过精心设计的数据整理、过滤与标注流程，以及基于扩散模型的运动生成主干网络（该网络可基于语言、音频及人体参考运动进行条件生成），应对上述挑战。大量实验验证了OMG作为全模态全身控制器的卓越性能，展示了其领先水平、模型扩展能力以及对新数据分布与模态的高效适应能力，这标志着向仿人机器人基础模型迈出了坚实一步。

title: SARM2: Multi-Task Stage Aware Reward Modeling for Self Improving Robotic Manipulation
summary: Fine-tuning vision-language-action (VLA) policies for long-horizon manipulation still relies heavily on behavior cloning, which requires costly high-quality demonstrations and keeps policies near the demonstration distribution. Reward models can reduce this dependence by reweighting demonstrations and providing dense supervision for on-robot reinforcement learning (RL), but they must be dense, accurate, and general. Existing methods fall short: task-specific stage-aware models are accurate but require per-task annotations, while general vision-language-model (VLM) reward models are broadly applicable but too coarse for fine-grained long-horizon progress. We introduce RM, a multi-task stage-aware reward model that combines an action-primitive-based stage estimator with a multi-gate Mixture-of-Experts (MMoE) value head to produce dense per-step rewards across manipulation tasks. Building on RM, we further propose SPIRAL (Self-Policy Improvement via Reward-Aligned Learning), an on-policy reward-guided framework that improves VLA policies from cheap autonomous rollouts. On a 10-task benchmark, RM reduces value-estimation MSE by 80% over the strongest baselines; when used in SPIRAL, it improves task success from around 50% to near-perfect performance on Folding Shorts (58% to 100%) and Cleaning Whiteboard (50% to 90%), showing that high-quality dense rewards are key to a stable robot data flywheel. Project website: https://qianzhong-chen.github.io/sarm2.github.io/.
tldr: This paper introduces SARM2, a multi-task stage-aware reward model using action-primitive-based stage estimation and MMoE value heads to produce dense per-step rewards for long-horizon manipulation. It further presents SPIRAL, an on-policy reward-guided framework that improves VLA policies from cheap autonomous rollouts, achieving near-perfect success on tasks like Folding Shorts and Cleaning Whiteboard.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了SARM2，一种多任务阶段感知奖励模型，通过基于动作基元的阶段估计和多门混合专家值头为长程操作任务生成密集的逐步骤奖励。并进一步提出了SPIRAL，一种在策略奖励引导框架，利用廉价自主 rollout 提升VLA策略性能，在折叠短裤和清洁白板等任务上实现了接近完美的成功率。
summary_zh:
**摘要：**  
针对长时域操作任务微调视觉-语言-动作策略仍严重依赖行为克隆，这不仅需要昂贵的高质量示范数据，还会使策略局限于示范数据分布范围内。奖励模型可通过重新加权示范数据并为机器人本体强化学习提供密集监督来降低这种依赖，但奖励模型必须满足密集、准确且通用的要求。现有方法存在不足：特定任务的阶段感知模型虽然准确，但需要逐任务标注；而通用的视觉-语言模型奖励模型虽适用广泛，但对于细粒度的长时域进度评估则过于粗糙。我们提出RM——一种多任务阶段感知奖励模型，它结合了基于动作原语的阶段估计器与多门控混合专家值函数头，可在不同操作任务中生成密集的逐步骤奖励。在RM基础上，我们进一步提出SPIRAL（基于奖励对齐学习的自我策略提升），这是一种基于策略的奖励引导框架，能够通过廉价的自主体 rollout 提升VLA策略。在包含10个任务的基准测试中，RM相比最强基线模型将值函数估计的均方误差降低了80%；当集成于SPIRAL中时，在“折叠短裤”任务中成功率从58%提升至100%，在“清洁白板”任务中从50%提升至90%，证明了高质量密集奖励对于构建稳定的机器人数据飞轮至关重要。项目网站：https://qianzhong-chen.github.io/sarm2.github.io/

title: MARCH: Model-Assisted Reinforcement Learning for the Perceptive Control of Humanoids over Sparse Footholds
summary: Perceptive bipedal locomotion over sparse terrain remains a difficult challenge: model-based methods are precise but brittle to uncertainty, while model-free methods are robust but struggle to discover the precise, constrained motions required for safety-critical locomotion where small errors can cause catastrophic failures. We propose a model-assisted reinforcement learning (RL) framework that combines both perspectives in three steps: (1) generate a safe reference trajectory using simplified models; (2) train a privileged teacher policy guided by a control Lyapunov function (CLF) reward built around the safe reference trajectory; and (3) distill the teacher into a vision-based student policy. We show that this model-assistance procedure produces physically grounded locomotion, improving sample efficiency, reducing the need for a complex learning curriculum, and achieving smoother locomotion behavior alongside stepping stone performance comparable to model-free baselines. We validate our approach in simulation and demonstrate successful deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot navigating sparse footholds with lateral constraints.
tldr: This paper proposes a model-assisted reinforcement learning framework for perceptive bipedal locomotion over sparse footholds, combining simplified model-based reference trajectories, CLF-guided teacher training, and vision-based student distillation to achieve robust and sample-efficient locomotion on a humanoid robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种模型辅助的强化学习框架，用于在稀疏立足点上实现有感知的双足运动，通过结合简化模型参考轨迹、控制李雅普诺夫函数引导的教师训练和基于视觉的学生蒸馏，在人形机器人上实现了鲁棒且样本高效的运动。
summary_zh: 感知型双足机器人在稀疏地形上的运动仍是一项艰巨挑战：基于模型的方法精确但易受不确定性影响，而基于无模型的方法鲁棒性强却难以发现安全关键型运动所需的精确约束动作——此类场景中微小误差可能导致灾难性故障。我们提出一种模型辅助的强化学习框架，通过三个步骤融合两种方法的优势：(1) 利用简化模型生成安全参考轨迹；(2) 基于该参考轨迹构建控制李雅普诺夫函数奖励，训练特权教师策略；(3) 将教师策略蒸馏为基于视觉的学生策略。实验表明，该模型辅助流程能产生符合物理规律的运动，提升样本效率，降低对复杂学习课程的需求，在实现更平滑运动行为的同时，达到与无模型基线相当的踏脚石性能。我们在仿真环境中验证了该方法，并在具有横向约束的稀疏立足点环境中成功部署于Unitree G1人形机器人。

title: Hierarchical Policies from Verbal and Egocentric Human Signals for Natural Human-Robot Interaction
summary: For natural human-robot interaction, a robot must understand human intent expressed not only through language but also through nonverbal signals such as gestures and gaze. However, current robot policies rely on language instructions as the sole interface for conveying intent, leaving nonverbal signals unused and placing the full burden of communication. In this work, we present EDITH, a robot framework that captures the human's nonverbal signals through continuous streams of first-person view and gaze from smart glasses, and uses them alongside language instructions as inputs to the robot policy. Our hardware system streams the human's first-person view, gaze, and speech to the robot in real time, transcribing the speech into language instructions. To handle these rich but noisy signals, we design a hierarchical policy in which a high-level policy infers the human's intent and produces a sequence of subtasks, where each subtask is represented as a fine-grained instruction paired with a keyframe that grounds the intent in the scene (e.g., the frame where the human points at the target object). A low-level policy then executes these subtasks. In our experiments on human-robot interactive tasks, EDITH enables the robot to act on the human's nonverbal signals even when intent is expressed only briefly, and significantly reduces user effort to convey intent compared to using language instructions alone. Visit our project page for source code and real-robot demo videos.
tldr: EDITH is a robot framework that uses egocentric video and gaze from smart glasses, together with language, to enable hierarchical policies that interpret human nonverbal signals and execute subtasks, reducing user effort in human-robot interaction.
tldr_zh: EDITH 是一个机器人框架，利用智能眼镜采集的第一人称视角视频和注视信号，结合语言指令，通过分层策略理解人类的非语言意图并执行子任务，从而降低人机交互中用户的表达负担。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
为实现自然的人机交互，机器人必须理解人类通过语言以及手势、注视等非语言信号所表达的意图。然而，当前的机器人策略仅将语言指令作为传达意图的唯一接口，忽视了非语言信号的使用，并将沟通的全部负担置于语言之上。在本工作中，我们提出EDITH——一种机器人框架，它通过智能眼镜持续获取人类的第一人称视角和注视信号，并将其与语言指令一同作为机器人策略的输入。我们的硬件系统能够实时传输人类的第一人称视角、注视及语音信息，并将语音转录为语言指令。为处理这些丰富但带有噪声的信号，我们设计了一种分层策略：高层策略推断人类意图并生成一系列子任务，每个子任务由一条细粒度指令及一个关键帧（例如，人类指向目标物体的帧）共同表示，从而将意图锚定于场景中；低层策略则执行这些子任务。在人机交互任务的实验中，EDITH使机器人能够在人类仅短暂表达意图时即对其非语言信号做出响应，与仅使用语言指令相比，显著降低了用户传达意图所需的工作量。请访问我们的项目页面获取源代码及真实机器人演示视频。

title: YUBI: Yielding Universal Bidigital Interface for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation at Scale
summary: We introduce Yielding Universal Bidigital Interface (YUBI), a finger-aligned gripper designed to enable intuitive, ergonomic, and scalable data collection for bimanual dexterous manipulation. While handheld data collection systems such as Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) enable affordable data collection, their bulky pistol-grip designs can pose ergonomic and usability challenges for fine-grained, dexterous manipulation tasks. To address this, YUBI presents a distinct design principle: yielding, finger-driven actuation that directly maps human finger movements to gripper jaw motion. Using the YUBI devices, we set up a data collection system with integrated VR-based 6 DoF tracking of the gripper, ensuring high-fidelity trajectory data acquisition. We curate a UMI-based dataset of unprecedented scale: 8,434 hours across 1.20M episodes and 119 tasks. Experiments show that YUBI offers advantages over the UMI gripper in versatility for complex bimanual tasks, dexterity, and operational efficiency. A single policy trained on the YUBI dataset transfers across multiple bimanual robots (UR, Franka, and ELEY) simply by mounting the gripper on each platform, confirming that the collected data are directly executable as policy supervision. We release the gripper hardware, data-collection software, and dataset as one integrated stack, offering the open community a reproducible path to large-scale data acquisition for advancing robotic foundation models.
tldr: YUBI introduces a finger-aligned gripper for ergonomic, scalable data collection for bimanual dexterous manipulation, yielding a large-scale dataset (8,434 hours, 1.20M episodes) that transfers across multiple bimanual robots.
tldr_zh: YUBI 提出了一种手指对齐的夹爪，用于人体工学、可扩展的双臂灵巧操作数据采集，生成了大规模数据集（8434小时，120万回合），可直接跨多种双臂机器人迁移。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
我们提出了屈服式通用双数字接口（YUBI），这是一种手指对齐的夹爪，旨在实现直观、人体工学化且可扩展的双臂灵巧操作数据采集。尽管如通用操作接口（UMI）等手持式数据采集系统成本低廉，但其笨重的手枪式握把设计可能在精细灵巧操作任务中带来人体工学与可用性挑战。为此，YUBI提出了一种独特的设计原则：通过屈服式手指驱动机制，将人类手指运动直接映射为夹爪开合动作。利用YUBI设备，我们搭建了一套集成基于VR的6自由度夹爪追踪的数据采集系统，确保高保真轨迹数据获取。我们整理了一个规模空前的基于UMI的数据集：涵盖120万条操作序列、8434小时数据及119项任务。实验表明，YUBI在复杂双臂任务的多功能性、灵巧性及操作效率方面均优于UMI夹爪。仅需将YUBI夹爪安装于各平台，基于其数据集训练单一策略即可直接迁移至多款双臂机器人（UR、Franka及ELEY），验证了所采集数据可直接作为策略监督信号。我们开源了夹爪硬件、数据采集软件及数据集，形成完整技术栈，为开源社区提供可复现的大规模数据采集路径，以推动机器人基础模型发展。

title: Flow Control: Steering Vision-Language-Action Models with Simple Real-Time Inputs
summary: We introduce flow control of vision-language-action (VLA) models, a simple and effective way to steer VLA actions in real-time through generic inputs, such as a keyboard. This method can be used out-of-the-box and does not require retraining or fine-tuning VLAs. It enables relatively crude user inputs to steer a VLA to align with user intent. The VLA transforms these inputs into action samples drawn from the VLA expert action distribution learned during training, so that the generated actions are high quality (conformity to the action expert distribution) and high fidelity (reflecting the user's intent). We demonstrate that flow control has many desirable properties: (1) flow control accurately and responsively steers robot actions with user inputs, (2) it is robust to suboptimal user inputs, (3) it enables users to steer VLAs to achieve significantly higher success rates and faster task completion, and (4) fine-tuning a VLA on flow control trajectories improves the autonomous policy. Together, these results provide a simple and intuitive way for users to help steer VLA actions, increasing task performance.
tldr: This paper introduces a method to steer vision-language-action (VLA) models in real-time using simple inputs like a keyboard, without retraining, by guiding action samples from the VLA's learned distribution to align with user intent.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种方法，通过键盘等简单输入实时引导视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，无需重新训练，利用VLA学习到的动作分布生成符合用户意图的高质量动作。
summary_zh: 我们引入了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的流控制方法，这是一种通过通用输入（如键盘）实时引导VLA动作的简单而有效的方式。该方法可直接使用，无需对VLA进行重新训练或微调，允许用户通过相对粗略的输入引导VLA对齐其意图。VLA将这些输入转换为从训练期间学习到的VLA专家动作分布中采样的动作样本，从而确保生成的动作既高质量（符合专家动作分布）又高保真（反映用户意图）。我们证明，流控制具有多项理想特性：（1）流控制能够准确且灵敏地通过用户输入引导机器人动作；（2）对次优用户输入具有鲁棒性；（3）使用户能够引导VLA实现显著更高的成功率和更快的任务完成速度；（4）在流控制轨迹上微调VLA可提升自主策略性能。综上所述，这些成果为用户提供了一种简单直观的方法来帮助引导VLA动作，从而提升任务表现。

title: Efficient-WAM: A 1B-Parameter World-Action Model with Low-Cost Future Imagination
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied control by coupling future visual prediction with action generation. However, most existing WAMs rely on photorealistic future prediction, which incurs high inference latency and makes real-time robot deployment difficult. This motivates a more efficient WAM design that preserves the control benefits of future visual prediction while reducing its inference cost. We introduce Efficient-WAM, a World-Action Model that reduces the cost of future imagination while preserving its control benefit. Efficient-WAM improves inference efficiency via a compact video expert transferred from WAN-2.2-5B, token-sparse video latents, and asymmetric video-action denoising that allocates fewer sampling steps to video than to actions. Instead of optimizing the future branch for visual fidelity, Efficient-WAM treats future video prediction as a compact guidance signal for action generation. Comprehensive experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 and real-world manipulation tasks show that Efficient-WAM maintains strong action performance despite visibly coarse future predictions. While maintaining competitive control capabilities, our 1B-parameter model can reduce per-chunk latency to around 100 ms during physical deployment, achieving a 30x speedup over existing WAMs.
tldr: Efficient-WAM reduces the inference latency of world-action models for embodied control by using a compact video expert, token-sparse video latents, and asymmetric denoising, achieving real-time deployment with minimal performance loss.
tldr_zh: Efficient-WAM通过紧凑的视频专家、稀疏视频令牌和非对称去噪降低世界动作模型的推理延迟，实现实时部署且性能损失极小。
summary_zh: 世界-动作模型（WAMs）通过将未来视觉预测与动作生成相结合，已成为具身控制领域一种前景广阔的范式。然而，现有的大多数WAMs依赖于逼真的未来预测，这会导致较高的推理延迟，使得实时机器人部署变得困难。这促使我们设计一种更高效的WAM，它既能保留未来视觉预测对控制的益处，又能降低其推理成本。我们提出了Efficient-WAM，这是一种世界-动作模型，它在降低未来想象成本的同时，保留了其对控制的好处。Efficient-WAM通过以下方式提升推理效率：一个从WAN-2.2-5B迁移而来的紧凑型视频专家模块、稀疏令牌的视频潜在表示，以及一种非对称的视频-动作去噪机制——该机制为视频分配比动作更少的采样步数。Efficient-WAM并未为了追求视觉保真度而优化未来分支，而是将未来视频预测视为动作生成的紧凑引导信号。在RoboTwin 2.0和真实世界操作任务上的综合实验表明，尽管未来预测在视觉上较为粗糙，Efficient-WAM仍能保持强大的动作性能。在保持具有竞争力的控制能力的同时，我们的1B参数模型在物理部署中可将每块的延迟降低至约100毫秒，相较于现有WAMs实现了30倍的加速。

title: GHOST: Hierarchical Sub-Goal Policies for Generalizing Robot Manipulation
summary:
We present GHOST, a framework for learning visuomotor manipulation policies that generalize beyond the training distribution. GHOST factorizes control into (i) a high-level policy that predicts the next sub-goal as a distribution over 3D end-effector poses from multi-view RGB-D observations, and (ii) a low-level goal-conditioned controller that executes embodiment-specific actions. To condition image-based policies on 3D goals, we introduce a simple spatial interface that projects predicted goals into the image plane and represents them as end-effector heatmaps. Across a suite of manipulation tasks, this hierarchical factorization consistently improves performance and robustness compared to a flat Diffusion Policy.
  Further, we show that this hierarchical interface also makes it easy to incorporate human demonstrations without relying on (noisy) action retargeting. As sub-goals are largely embodiment-agnostic, we train the high-level policy on human video to specify how learned skills should be applied and composed, while keeping the low-level policy trained purely on robot data. This hierarchy enables adaptation to novel objects and task variations using a small number of human demonstrations.
tldr: GHOST introduces a hierarchical framework that separates sub-goal prediction (as 3D end-effector poses) from low-level goal-conditioned control, improving generalization and enabling human video demonstration for manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: GHOST提出一种分层框架，将子目标预测（3D末端执行器位姿）与底层目标条件控制分离，提升了泛化能力，并允许使用人类视频演示进行操作任务。
summary_zh: 我们提出了GHOST框架，用于学习能够泛化至训练分布之外的视觉运动操作策略。该框架将控制分解为：(i) 高层策略，通过多视角RGB-D观测预测末端执行器三维位姿的概率分布作为下一子目标；(ii) 低层目标条件控制器，执行具身化的具体动作。为将基于图像策略与三维目标条件关联，我们引入简洁的空间接口：将预测目标投影至图像平面并以末端执行器热力图形式表征。在一系列操作任务中，相较于平面扩散策略，这种层次化解耦持续提升了性能与鲁棒性。进一步研究表明，该层次化接口还能便捷融入人类示教，无需依赖（含噪声的）动作重定向。由于子目标在很大程度上与具身形态无关，我们利用人类演示视频训练高层策略，以规定习得技能的应用与组合方式，同时保持低层策略纯由机器人数据训练。这种层次化架构使得仅需少量人类示教即可适应新物体与任务变体。

title: Beyond APIs: Probing the Limits of MLLMs in Physical Tool Use
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at utilizing digital APIs and increasingly serve as the "brain" of embodied AI, instructing robots to interact with the physical world. In such embodied settings, a central capability is the use of physical tools, which underpins MLLMs' ability to assist humans in real-world tasks. Despite the importance, MLLMs' proficiency in physical tool use remains largely unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce PhysTool-Bench, the first physical tool-use benchmark designed to evaluate MLLMs' ability to comprehend real-world scenarios, identify physical tools, and plan their use. PhysTool-Bench comprises 2,510 queries over 2,678 real-world physical tools spanning diverse domains, including manufacturing, electrical work, agriculture, and healthcare. Concretely, models are evaluated along two primary dimensions: 1) recognizing all physical tools present in the scene, and 2) planning the tool selection and use sequence based on the instruction and visual context. Across 13 leading MLLMs, even the strongest model (Gemini-3.1-Pro) identifies only 58.7% of tools in a scene and completes merely 21.0% of queries end-to-end. Our analysis reveals a two-level deficit: MLLMs struggle to perceive tools in realistic scenes, and the much larger drop at the planning stage further indicates a lack of functional commonsense for mapping perceived tools onto task semantics, pinpointing a critical bottleneck for the development of practical embodied AI.
tldr: Introduces PhysTool-Bench, the first benchmark to evaluate MLLMs on physical tool use in real-world scenes, revealing severe shortcomings in tool perception and functional planning that pose critical bottlenecks for embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 提出PhysTool-Bench，首个评估多模态大模型在真实场景中识别和使用物理工具的基准，揭示了模型在工具感知和功能规划上的严重不足，指出这构成了具身AI发展的关键瓶颈。
summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在调用数字API方面表现卓越，并日益成为具身AI的“大脑”，指导机器人进行物理世界交互。在此类具身场景中，核心能力在于使用物理工具，这构成了MLLMs辅助人类完成现实世界任务的基础。尽管这一能力至关重要，但MLLMs在物理工具使用方面的熟练程度仍鲜有探究。为填补这一空白，我们提出了PhysTool-Bench——首个专为评估MLLMs理解现实场景、识别物理工具及规划其使用能力而设计的物理工具使用基准。PhysTool-Bench包含2,678个现实物理工具上的2,510个查询，这些工具覆盖制造、电工、农业及医疗等多个领域。具体而言，模型评估沿两个主要维度展开：1）识别场景中所有出现的物理工具；2）根据指令与视觉上下文规划工具选择及使用顺序。在13个领先的MLLMs中，即便最强的模型（Gemini-3.1-Pro）也仅能识别场景中58.7%的工具，且端到端完成21.0%的查询。我们的分析揭示了两层缺陷：MLLMs难以在真实场景中感知工具，而规划阶段更为显著的性能下降进一步表明其缺乏将感知到的工具映射到任务语义的功能性常识——这精准指出了实用型具身AI发展的关键瓶颈。

title: Next Forcing: Causal World Modeling with Multi-Chunk Prediction
summary: Autoregressive video generation has emerged as a powerful paradigm for World Action Models (WAMs). However, existing approaches suffer from slow training convergence and limited converged accuracy, particularly at high frame rates, as the training supervision is confined to the current chunk without explicit signals about future dynamics; they also suffer from slow inference due to iterative video denoising. In this paper, we present Next Forcing, a multi-chunk prediction (MCP) framework for causal world modeling that enables faster training, higher accuracy, and accelerated inference. Inspired by multi-token prediction in large language models, Next Forcing introduces an MCP training objective that augments the main model with lightweight auxiliary MCP modules to simultaneously denoise video chunks at multiple future temporal horizons (next$^1$, next$^2$, next$^3$ chunks). These MCP modules form a causal chain across prediction depths, where intermediate features fused from multiple layers of the main model are leveraged to predict future dynamics, allowing near-future predictions to inform farther-future ones and providing dense multi-scale temporal supervision back to the main model. During training, the MCP modules significantly accelerate convergence and improve converged accuracy, especially at high frame rates: at 50 fps, Next Forcing achieves a 93.1% relative improvement over LingBot-VA at 5k training steps and 2.3x faster convergence, and establishes new state-of-the-art results on the RoboTwin benchmark (94.1/93.5% on Clean/Random). At inference, the MCP modules can be retained to predict the next video chunk in parallel with the current one, achieving 2x inference acceleration. Next Forcing also demonstrates significant improvements on PhyWorld, a benchmark evaluating adherence to physical laws in video generation, and over 50% FVD reduction on general video pretraining.
tldr: Next Forcing introduces a multi-chunk prediction (MCP) framework for causal world action models, enabling faster training, higher accuracy, and 2x inference acceleration by simultaneously denoising video chunks at multiple future horizons.
tldr_zh: Next Forcing 提出了一种多块预测（MCP）框架，用于因果世界动作模型，通过同时去噪多个未来时间步的视频块，实现更快的训练、更高的精度和2倍推理加速。
summary_zh: 自回归视频生成已成为世界动作模型（WAMs）的一种强大范式。然而，现有方法存在训练收敛缓慢和收敛精度有限的问题，尤其是在高帧率下，因为训练监督局限于当前数据块，缺乏关于未来动态的明确信号；此外，由于迭代视频去噪，推理速度也较慢。本文提出"Next Forcing"——一种用于因果世界建模的多块预测（MCP）框架，可实现更快的训练、更高的精度和加速推理。受大语言模型中多标记预测的启发，Next Forcing引入了一种MCP训练目标，通过轻量级辅助MCP模块增强主模型，以同时对多个未来时间视界（下一、第二、第三帧块）的视频块进行去噪。这些MCP模块在预测深度上形成因果链，利用从主模型多个层融合的中间特征来预测未来动态，使近未来预测能够为更远未来预测提供信息，并向主模型返回密集的多尺度时间监督。训练过程中，MCP模块显著加速收敛并提高收敛精度，尤其是在高帧率下：在50 fps时，Next Forcing在5000训练步数下相比LingBot-VA实现93.1%的相对提升，且收敛速度提升2.3倍，并在RoboTwin基准测试（Clean/Random分别为94.1%/93.5%）上创下新的最先进结果。推理时，可保留MCP模块，使其与当前视频块并行预测下一视频块，实现2倍推理加速。Next Forcing在评估视频生成物理规律遵循性的PhyWorld基准上同样表现出显著改进，并在通用视频预训练中实现超过50%的FVD降低。

title: Envision4D: Envisioning Visual Futures via Feed-forward 4D Gaussian Splatting for Autonomous Driving
summary: Forecasting the future evolution of dynamic scenes is crucial in autonomous driving. However, existing feed-forward paradigms are primarily designed for interpolation. When extended to future extrapolation, they suffer from ghosting artifacts under large displacements and are constrained by simplified motion assumptions or strict future priors. To overcome these challenges, we propose Envision4D, a fully self-supervised feed-forward framework for pose-free future extrapolation. Specifically, we introduce a Future Pose Prediction module that infers future camera parameters via an iterative denoising process. Furthermore, to capture non-linear dynamics, we propose In-layer Temporal Attention and employ Conditioned Motion Lifting, which transforms the highly uncertain extrapolation process into robust relational mappings. Finally, a Progressive Training Strategy is utilized to stabilize unsupervised motion learning against error accumulation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Envision4D achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming existing methods in future view synthesis.
tldr: Envision4D is a self-supervised feed-forward framework for future scene extrapolation in autonomous driving, using future pose prediction and conditioned motion lifting to achieve state-of-the-art future view synthesis without ghosting artifacts.
tldr_zh: Envision4D是一种用于自动驾驶中未来场景外推的自监督前馈框架，通过未来位姿预测和条件运动提升，在无伪影的条件下实现了最先进的未来视角合成。
summary_zh: 预测动态场景的未来演化对自动驾驶至关重要。然而，现有的前馈范式主要针对插值设计。当扩展到未来外推时，它们在大位移情况下会出现重影伪影，并且受限于简化的运动假设或严格的未来先验。为克服这些挑战，我们提出Envision4D——一种完全自监督的前馈框架，用于无位姿未来外推。具体而言，我们引入未来位姿预测模块，通过迭代去噪过程推断未来相机参数。此外，为捕捉非线性动态，我们提出层内时序注意力机制，并采用条件运动提升技术，将高度不确定的外推过程转化为稳健的关系映射。最后，利用渐进式训练策略来稳定无监督运动学习，防止误差累积。大量实验表明，Envision4D达到了最先进的性能，在未来视角合成中显著优于现有方法。

title: LAFP: Preserving Latent Action Structure in Latent Policy Learning via Flow Matching
summary: Learning high-quality latent actions from large-scale unlabeled videos, coupled with limited real-world interaction data for training an action decoder, has emerged as a promising paradigm for scalable latent policy learning. However, existing approaches typically rely on behavior cloning, which tends to collapse inherently multimodal action distributions into unimodal ones, thereby degrading the pretrained latent action structure. While flow matching provides a potential alternative, directly applying it leads to a misalignment between latent actions and physical actions during action decoder training, due to the stochastic nature of the learned policy. To address these, we propose Latent Action Flow Policy (LAFP), which leverages flow matching for latent policy learning and introduces an inference-time interpolation mechanism to mitigate stochasticity-induced misalignment. Experimental results demonstrate that LAFP consistently outperforms prior methods on downstream imitation learning tasks, achieving up to 10-15% improvement in success rate while incurring less than 1x additional inference overhead.
tldr: LAFP uses flow matching with an inference-time interpolation mechanism to preserve latent action structures during latent policy learning, improving imitation learning success rates by 10-15%.
tldr_zh: LAFP 通过流匹配和推理时插值机制保留潜在动作结构，在模仿学习任务中提升成功率达10-15%。
summary_zh: 从大规模未标注视频中学习高质量的潜在动作，并结合少量真实世界交互数据训练动作解码器，已成为可扩展潜在策略学习的一种有前景的范式。然而，现有方法通常依赖行为克隆，这种方式倾向于将本质上的多模态动作分布退化为单模态分布，从而破坏了预训练的潜在动作结构。尽管流匹配提供了一种潜在的替代方案，但由于学习策略的随机性，直接应用流匹配会导致在动作解码器训练过程中潜在动作与物理动作之间出现对齐偏差。为解决这些问题，我们提出了潜在动作流策略（LAFP），该方法利用流匹配进行潜在策略学习，并引入一种推理时插值机制以减轻随机性导致的对齐偏差。实验结果表明，LAFP在下游模仿学习任务中持续优于先前方法，成功率提升最高达10-15%，同时额外推理开销低于1倍。

title: EM-Fall: Embodied mmWave Sensing for Day-and-Night Fall Detection on Humanoid Robots
summary: Falls are one of the leading causes of injury and hospitalization among elderly individuals, making reliable fall awareness an essential capability for safety monitoring in residential environments. However, existing fall detection systems often rely on wearable devices or fixed sensing installations, which may suffer from low user compliance, limited spatial coverage, or degraded performance under occlusion and poor lighting conditions. In this work, we propose \textbf{EM-Fall}, an embodied fall detection framework deployed on a mobile humanoid robot. The system integrates millimeter-wave (mmWave) sensing with robotic mobility, allowing the robot to actively adjust its sensing viewpoint and maintain target observability across rooms and under occlusion. To address interference in complex residential environments, including pet motion and multipath artifacts, we design a human-centered perception pipeline combined with lightweight temporal modeling to capture motion evolution before, during, and after fall events. We evaluate the proposed system across eight real indoor environments with four participants and construct an in-home mmWave fall detection dataset. Experimental results show that the embodied mobile sensing paradigm improves monitoring continuity and maintains robust fall detection performance under diverse environmental conditions. The proposed framework provides a practical solution for robot-assisted safety monitoring in home environments.
